items.title: Lemon Nash Interview, 1959-10-03
items.q: "Do you know that was the first fella I played with?" "I played guitar and he played mandolin." "August and I, we played around together. I'd say around about six years"

ctx.x: We want to find August sometime, his nephew in Chicago. No, August dead.

August is dead? I just got a message, he died. Do you know that was the first fella I played with? You brought my remembers. The rabbit's little nephew, August, played a mandolin. He and I was the first two young fellas around, they used to go around and certainly, just two of us. I played guitar and he played mandolin. August died, a fella, I met his uncle. His uncle told me that he died, it must be true, so he died in Chicago.
You reckon his uncle would remember any of those songs?
